svg.text: py-spy record -o docs/lab08_search.svg --rate 250 -- C:\Users\Artem\miniconda3\python.exe -c import itertools; from pathlib import Path; from findex.store import open_index; from findex.search import search; ws = ['world','war','europe','united','states','city','music','history','system','water','time','country','people','science','language']; qs = [' '.join(c) for c in itertools.islice(itertools.combinations(ws, 3), 250)]; ctx = open_index(Path('data/index.bin')); ix = ctx.__enter__(); [search(ix, q, k=10) for q in qs]; ctx.__exit__(None, None, None)
